## Description {#details}

<p>Class representing coefficient of floating-point addend.</p>


<p>This class needs to be highly efficient, which is especially true for the constructor. As of I write this comment, the cost of the default constructor is merely 4-byte-store-zero (Assuming compiler is able to perform write-merging).</p>


<p>Definition at line 49 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/instcombine/instcombineaddsub-cpp">InstCombineAddSub.cpp</a>.</p>
